title: 100位科技富豪：九个月增8450亿美元，旧金山地产市场为何最先变样？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The flood of investment into AI is creating staggering wealth.
segments.zh: 大量资金涌入人工智能领域，正创造出惊人的财富。

segments.en: This could be the largest, quickest and most concentrated wealth creation event in history.
segments.zh: 这可能是历史上规模最大、速度最快、最集中的财富创造事件。

segments.en: The 100 tech fortunes in the world's 500 richest people gained a combined $845 billion
segments.zh: 全球500位最富有者中的100位科技富豪，合计财富增长了8450亿美元，

segments.en: through the first nine months of the year. That's the most ever over that time period.
segments.zh: 这是今年前九个月的数据，创下同期历史最高纪录。

segments.en: Anthropics IPO is set to bring multi-billion dollar gains to its investors.
segments.zh: Anthropic的IPO将为其市场参与者带来数十亿美元的收益。

segments.en: And much of this wealth is centered around one city, San Francisco.
segments.zh: 而这些财富很大程度上集中在一座城市——旧金山。

segments.en: This is a city that's very used to booms and it's also very used to busts.
segments.zh: 这座城市对繁荣并不陌生，也对低迷习以为常。

segments.en: But this one feels different. Especially if you realize just how many people are getting rich on this
segments.zh: 但这一次感觉不同，尤其是当你意识到有多少人正借此致富，

segments.en: and how large their fortunes are. But the boom comes with a cost.
segments.zh: 以及他们的财富规模有多大。但繁荣也伴随着代价。

segments.en: This is a place where the rich are getting richer. And if you're not getting on that bandwagon, you're following behind.
segments.zh: 这里富者愈富。如果你不跟上这波浪潮，就会落在后面。

segments.en: Just a few years ago, San Francisco was in deep trouble.
segments.zh: 就在几年前，旧金山还深陷困境。

segments.en: Office vacancies were skyrocketing. People were working remotely.
segments.zh: 写字楼空置率飙升，人们远程办公。

segments.en: You'd walk down the street. There was a lot of homelessness, a lot of crime.
segments.zh: 走在街上，无家可归者和犯罪问题很多。

segments.en: It was a city that felt kind of like it had been hollowed out.
segments.zh: 这座城市感觉像是被掏空了。

segments.en: That's totally different from what is going on right now in the city.
segments.zh: 这与现在城市的情况完全不同。

segments.en: Although its issues are still very much present, the city is experiencing a renaissance.
segments.zh: 尽管问题依然存在，但这座城市正在复兴。

segments.en: In some ways, it's great to be in San Francisco right now. It's busier, restaurants are making more money, coffee shops are opening.
segments.zh: 在某些方面，现在的旧金山很棒。更繁忙，餐厅赚更多钱，咖啡店开张。

segments.en: The biggest impact that you can see is on the real estate market.
segments.zh: 最明显的影响体现在地产市场上。
